rationale: PR #326 showed that once a complete publication exposes multiple required semantic components, a publication-global PRIMARY role is not semantically valid. This change extends the governed topic catalogue with question-selection metadata, adds one generic deterministic component selector, passes the exact governed requested outcome into evidence resolution context, and marks only the uniquely selected published component PRIMARY. Ambiguous multi-component questions receive no PRIMARY role.
authority_impact: No product, claim, or publication authority is added. Selection is presentation/evidence-routing metadata derived from the exact user-requested outcome plus versioned governed topic definitions. The selector cannot create evidence, change certification, change publication contents, or infer claim outcomes.
